hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */dist/*|*/package-lock.json) echo "Blocked: $f is generated; edit src/ or package.json and rebuild/reinstall." >&2; exit 2;; esac
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npx tsc --noEmit >&2 || exit 2;; esac
